notes.content:
[Server Downtime]

[Server Downtime]
Jun. 13, 07:00 - 10:00 (UTC +8)

I. New Bane Slayer Gameplay
◦ A new BOSS will be refreshed weekly for players to Challenge
◦ You can select up to 9 Debuffs to increase Difficulty and boost progress upon successful completion. Available Debuffs refresh weekly
◦ Boost progress to earn progress rewards which refresh weekly
◦ The highest Score you earn and shortest time in a single round will be recorded as the player's best performance of the week. The top 100 players by best performance will enter the leaderboard
◦ Leaderboard will offer exclusive title [Slayer Lord], Gear, and Token Rewards. Rewards will be sent to Mailbox after settlement
◦ New [Bane Slayer] exclusive Shop, where exclusive Gear, Sigils, and Resource Rewards can be exchanged

II. New Gear: [Phoenix Feather Crown] and [Dragon Essence Ring], obtainable via [Bane Slayer]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/dcfbf3588c0aa1cb0aac70a3f0c7b94b493961d1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/c02e0a354c3d9b4dae67ec662e722a14a6db32a6.png[/img]

III. Arena Optimizations
◦ After a match ends, players will return to the team interface by default
◦ Personal information now displays Arena Points
◦ Water pools removed from 1v1, some water pools removed from 5v5

IV. [Inferno Crucible] and [The Kilocliffs] merged into [Frozen Inferno] Map
◦ Map Rules:
▪ Map simultaneously spawns [Almas, the Abominable Snowman] and [Agni, the Crimson Arbiter]
▪ Map simultaneously drops [Ice Coin] and [Ember]
▪ Two modes added: Safe and Conflict
◦ Schedule
▪ Conflict Mode: Open daily from 12:00 to 02:00 (UTC +8)
▪ Safe Mode: Open on Mondays and Wednesdays from 20:00 to 22:00 (UTC +8)

V. [Sunset Desert] changed to Safe Mode

VI. Archive Optimizations
◦ New Gear Archive added
◦ Weapon Archive optimized
▪ New Weapon Points Rewards added
• 400 Points: Random Mythic Sigil (1 of 2) x1, Legendary Sigil Selection Bundle x3, All-Element Mod Ore Bundle x3
• 500 Points: Random Mythic Sigil (1 of 4) x1, Forging Core x1, All-Element Mod Ore Bundle x3
▪ Weapons now feature elemental type indicators and filtering

VII. New Stash 21 & 22

VIII. New Monthly Perks and Permanent Perks

IX. Shop Adjustments
◦ Added Daily/Weekly/Monthly Bundles
◦ Mysterious Shop now offers Mastery Shard Selection Bundle, purchasable with Crystal

X. Balance Adjustments
◦ Gold Suozi Armor:
▪ SPD: 100 → 80
▪ ATK Boost when HP above 50%: 30% → 20%
◦ Lotus Silk Cloudtreaders:
▪ SPD: 150 → 120
▪ CRIT DMG Boost when HP above 50%: 50 → 30
▪ Dodge Boost when HP at or below 50%: 200 → 150
◦ Set Effect Adjustments:
▪ Four-Piece Set Passive: When HP above 50%, CRIT over 100% converts to 2x CRIT DMG → converts to equivalent CRIT DMG
▪ Four-Piece Set Passive: When HP at or below 50%, reduces incoming CRIT and final CRIT DMG by 25% → reduces by 20%
▪ Four-Piece Set Active: When HP above 50%, reduces Hero Skill CD by 30s → reduces by 15s
◦ Winter Edict:
▪ Passive Effect: Enemies in range receive 4% of caster's Max HP as DMG every 2s → 5% of caster's Max HP
▪ Active Skill: Freezes target enemy unit for 1.2s, dealing DMG every 0.3s → Freezes for 1.5s, dealing DMG every 0.25s, with slightly reduced single-hit DMG but slightly increased total DMG
▪ γ Modification: Freeze duration extended by 0.3s → extended by 0.5s
◦ Almas' Carrot: Ice Weapon basic attack or skill-triggered snowballs deal +35% DMG
◦ Arcane Origins Robe: While Arcane Shield is active, restores 25% ATK as HP per sec → 40% ATK as HP
◦ Moonshard - Nightmare:
▪ Base attack interval reduced: 0.6 → 0.4, Stamina Cost reduced
▪ Passive Effect: Additional Poison DMG when awakens from Nightmare: 30% → 50%
◦ Spartan:
▪ Talent Pearl I: During first 5s of Spartan Stance, SPD +300 → SPD +500
▪ Talent Pearl I: Stamina Cost for Spartan Stance reduced by 8 → reduced by 10
▪ Talent Pearl II: During Spartan Stance, DMG from distant enemies is reduced by up to 15% → up to 25%
◦ Witch:
▪ Talent Pearl I: When Cauldron's tracking poison hits a hero, it reduces Max HP by 2.5% per stack, up to 20 stacks → 5% per stack, up to 10 stacks
▪ Talent Pearl II: When Cauldron launches tracking poison, there is a 40% chance to fire 2 times consecutively, and a 20% chance to fire 3 times → 50% chance to fire 2 times, 25% chance to fire 3 times
▪ Talent: Cauldron's firing interval -0.05/0.1/0.15/0.25s → 0.1/0.2/0.3/0.4s
◦ Mage:
▪ Talent Pearl I: Blizzard has a 25% chance to add +1 Freeze stack → 50% chance to add +1 Freeze stack
▪ Talent Pearl II: Blizzard has a 20% chance to freeze enemies for 1s (CD: 2s) → 100% chance to freeze enemies for 1s (CD: 3s)
◦ Paladin:
▪ Talent Pearl I: After casting Divine Protection, grants Ally units +200 SPD → grants +500 SPD
▪ Talent Pearl I: When blocking with Passive Skill, there is a 30% chance to increase SPD → 100% chance to increase SPD
▪ Talent Pearl II: Divine Protection CD -25s → CD -40s
▪ Talent Pearl II: When blocking with Passive Skill, there is a 40% chance to recover 4% of Max HP → 100% chance to recover 5% of Max HP
◦ Mummy:
▪ Talent Pearl II: When using Weapon Skill, summon 1 Scarab → summon 3 Scarabs
◦ Ninja:
▪ Talent Pearl I: Active Skill CD -50%, DMG -40% → CD -60%, DMG -30%
▪ Talent: Active Skill DMG to Shield +5/10/15/25% → 10/20/30/50%
▪ Talent: Active Skill SPD Down Effect +5/10/15/25% → 10/20/30/50%
▪ Talent: Active Skill HP Recovery +0.2/0.4/0.6/1% Max HP → 0.4/0.8/1.2/2% Max HP
◦ Demoness:
▪ Talent Pearl I: Each time Meteor hits a Hero, CD reduced by 7s → CD reduced by 9s
▪ Talent Pearl II: When dealing Fire Weapon DMG, there is a 50% chance to summon a small Meteor, CD 8s → 100% chance to summon a small Meteor, CD 5s
◦ Bombano:
▪ Talent Pearl I: Bomb hits inflict 40% Wound Effect → 60% Wound Effect
▪ Talent Pearl II: When using Weapon Skill, there is a 50% chance to release 1 extra Bomb → 100% chance to release 1 extra Bomb
◦ McCluck:
▪ Talent Pearl I: Bow Weapon ASPD +10% → ASPD +20%
▪ Talent Pearl I: When transforming into Chicken Run, SPD +200 → SPD +500
▪ Talent Pearl II: Bow Weapons have a 50% chance to ignore target's Dodge, +15% DMG → 100% chance
▪ Talent: Bow Weapon ASPD +1/2/3/5% → 2/4/6/10%
◦ Swordsman:
▪ Talent Pearl I: When switching to sword-type Weapons, Weapon CRIT +8, CRIT DMG +20 for 3s → Weapon CRIT +10, CRIT DMG +20 for 5s
◦ Berserker:

◦ Wyvern:
▪ Talent Pearl I: When triggering marsh, if no allies are in range, Wyvern additionally restores HP (50% of HP recovered by the marsh) and gains SPD Up for 1.5s → restores HP (25% of HP recovered by the marsh) and gains SPD Up for 1s
▪ Talent: Required move distance to trigger marsh -4/8/12/20% → 3/6/9/15%
◦ Spiky Boy:
▪ Talent Pearl II: Active Skill becomes Passive, but only with 50% of DMG Return → 75% of DMG Return

XI. Some Repairs and Adjustments
◦ Repaired the issue where the Active Skill of [Zeus Mallet] in Yin status could blink to abnormal positions
◦ Repaired the issue where the Yin-Yang status of [Zeus Mallet] would reset after switching Maps
◦ Repaired the issue where the Active Skill DMG of [Lava Fang] did not correctly receive Weapon Skill DMG bonus
◦ Adjusted the setting of [Arcane Origins Robe] consuming revival attempts upon death in the arena. Now, [Arcane Origins Robe] that has already consumed revival attempts outside can trigger the revival effect in the arena, and if revival attempts have not been consumed outside, triggering the revival effect in the arena will not consume external revival attempts
◦ Repaired the issue where the Hero Icon did not change after resurrection in the arena
◦ Repaired the abnormal issue during external resurrection after resurrection in the arena
◦ Optimized some white screen issues

Welcome to the new update for Hero's Land! This update is packed with new content, exciting gameplay features, and a host of rewards. Let's take a look at what's coming your way!

I. New Events

Complete quests to earn Pass EXP and meet requirements to unlock rewards such as Wish Coin, Ice Coin, Acorn, Talent related items, and the new Mascot—[Inferno Wraith]

Yeti Duo now has a new Difficulty III level. With tougher mechanics and better rewards, it's a true test for those seeking a challenge!

Frost Fist increases ATK while moving and inflicts CC effect with its unique skill. It's a perfect match for the new hero [Fighter]. Available from the Difficulty III Yeti Duo.

Found in the Sky Realm, Lightning Feather boosts ASPD based on the hero's SPD and grants immunity to control effects after using a skill.

1. New Accessory System
Personalize your heroes with new accessories! The [Card - Accessory] interface now has a slot for equipping items that will enhance your hero's appearance.

2. Sacred Dragon: 2 Variants (Dye), unlocked by using Dye Fruit

notes.title: 【Hero's Land】THE DEVS BLOG#2
notes.content:
Check out our The Devs Blog #2 where we are introducing recent map design changes and other system adjustments. Please read on!

[h2]Map Design[/h2]
We’ve overhauled our map system to streamline the overall design philosophy. By redesigning select map regions to clearly convey their functions and adding new map markers to improve readability, we’ve enhanced overall immersion. At the same time, we’ve added new content, such as the Giant’s Village and Witch’s Mushroom Hut, to synergize map content with our game’s theme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/22c8b3d2b53fbbb04f0698742c525f4abf36ecd7.png[/img]

[h2]Hero Design[/h2]
We’re gradually adding new heroes with exciting skills. Each new hero underwent an exhaustive design process in which multiple iterations were developed and tested before the final version.  As an example, what skills should a Druid possess? Summoning wolves? Morphing into a giant bear? Redirecting the forces of nature? Our team vigorously debated and carefully tested each of the above in actual gameplay scenarios before settling on the best one.
Guess which one we chose in the comments section!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/a2bc1318437f22e1af54f33e39efe6b16d739d75.png[/img]

[h2]Other gameplay [/h2]
In addition, we also added a host of game systems such as tournaments, achievements, friends and store.  Our team is constantly optimizing these systems to provide players with the best gaming experience.
Players can now compete in Top 10 battles to unlock rich tier rewards.
The new friend system makes it easy for players to befriend each other and quickly team up for PvP battles or boss fights for epic equipment drops.
You can now access the store to unlock new heroes and pets by drawing shards.
Unlock in-game achievements with playtime and get additional rewards!
To ensure everyone can experience the game on schedule, Steel Studio are in a mad dash to finalize the game by making small changes each day and large patches every week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/f333df107a9d349e63fa7a9931016ad29a2fbb4c.png[/img]
（The numerical value shown in the design draft is an average of the display meaning, please refer to the online version for the actual situation）

[h2]Art Design[/h2]
We’ve listened to player feedback and heard your requests for a pet panda, so we are working this concept into the game. Our artists have been designing pet pandas and they want to share some concept sketches so everyone can get a sneak peek.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/8550b7db6b9baea048adf18b4512d301e442a371.png[/img]

That’s all for the dev diary. If you have any questions, feel free to ask in the comments section.

notes.title: 【Hero’s Land】THE DEVS BLOG #1
notes.content:
Hi! How is it going? This is Iron Guy from Hero’s Land developer team. I am glad to let you know Hero’s Land will launch on Steam on 18th May. I will introduce what’s Hero’s Land to you generally. Hope the first look of in-game and some info would be useful for you to know more about Hero’s Land.

[h3]【Game Summary】[/h3]
[Hero's Land] is a Roguelike RPG game that combines "casual" and "funny". In order to alleviate the tension and excitement brought by the meat pigeon game, we have added many very interesting game functions in the game. For example: opening random weapon in wild, building up base, live ranking, villain red name system, fishing, collection functions, etc.

You can get a character by lottery system to check whether you can own a particularly interesting character or not! Each character has its own skills. Although their skills are cool, [Hero’s Land] is more about social interaction! Developing in groups with close friends, sneaking into the enemy team to sell calculations, working together to kill bosses and robbing orange equipment, etc., all require communication to achieve. Try to open the microphone game, you will find that this game is so love-hate.
We don't want the game's map to be so peaceful. 

Therefore, you may stray into the jungle and be entangled by vines, and you will be killed by the enemy if you are not careful. Maybe you will unknowingly break into the mushroom formation where the elite monsters live, and if you want to escape from death, use the ejection of the mushroom to escape quickly. Also, you have to be careful of the bushes and coffins on the map, often the enemy hides in them and waits for them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/6fb26408607779d0648f5c985602f0824cbf1294.jpg[/img]

[h3]【Gameplay】[/h3]
We tend to bring some different gameplay experience for you among thousands of MMORPG. We developed several game contents which worth you to expect. Follow my steps to explore what can you do in Hero’s Land.

[b]【DIY An Exclusive Base】[/b]
Besides gaining hero’s levels, we would like to release your nature in Hero’s Land. You can set up your base when you reach the relative levels and unlock buildings. Tower, Spikeweed, Defensive Wall with exclusive types of hitting. Such as, Poisonous Spikeweed, Ice Arrow, Bonfire with Restoring HP. You need to collect materials to st up building.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/c83b26be4c27096d95b2eb9b6052270981e9b6b8.jpg[/img]

[b]【A Little Different Pet System】[/b]
In many games, it allows players bring several pets at the same time, but only release one of them as player’s battle pet. In Hero’s Land, you can release 3 pets as battle pets which can company with you and fight against with enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/08bfb2fdc9f6ffee5f838f592697f02345f7b296.png[/img]

Pets in Hero’s Land can evolve. Not only their shape changed, their HP, ATK and other values were increased greatly. 

Different types of pets have exclusive skills, like frozen, faint, attack by storm,etc. Pets could assist you to slash all enemies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/7569a47b775589fc43dfa407b62bf62119dd69dd.png[/img]

[b]【Various Weapons】[/b]
We create numbers of special weapons and put them in chests. When you find chests in the wild and destroy them, you will get different types and levels of weapons randomly. You can use Double Pole, One-Handed Sword, Bow, Magic Wand and Spear in game. Each weapon has different attack and skill effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770674/daad7fd3003396b587fecf21f2c842877b81cc8e.jpg[/img]

That's it for the first dev blog. I roughly explained to you some of the game content in [Hero’s Land]. If you are more interested in which game content, please leave a comment in the comment area below. I will explain it to you in the next log based on the content of the most popular comments.

see you!
